thread_analysis.thread_summary: Short internal report review thread (58 lines) for AlpsAlpine 19AVN A2DP profile test. Two compliance issues flagged by Sakai: (1) A2DP/SNK/SYN/[ID] test case is in the test plan but was not executed; (2) profile version was written in two-digit format (X.Y) instead of the required three-digit format (X.Y.Z). Both issues require correction before report approval. Low-value thread — operational review only.
all_questions_found: Is a missing (unexecuted) test case in the test plan acceptable?
Does the A2DP profile version require a three-digit format (X.Y.Z)?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Two formatting/completeness rules for Bluetooth profile test reports: test cases in the plan must either be executed or formally excluded with justification; profile versions must use the three-digit X.Y.Z notation.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Compliance report review checks for test completeness (no gaps) and correct version notation format. Both are binary — either correct or flag for fix.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Reports with incomplete test coverage documentation or incorrect version format will be rejected in SIG review.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: The engineer who wrote the report (Nakayama) left a test case gap and used incorrect version format — both are basic report quality issues.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Build a report QC checklist that includes: (a) verify all test plan cases have results or exclusion notes; (b) verify all profile versions use X.Y.Z (three-digit) format.
